current_evidence: The official 'Make a planning application' page hosts the Local Validation and Sustainability Checklist as Appendices A-D (Appendix C cites the Biodiversity Gain (Irreplaceable Habitat) Regulations 2024, so it has been updated since 2024). No adoption or publication date is stated in the text, and a search found no newer list.

issues.detail: Grokbot marked the link 'not readable: blocked/404/login', but the page loads and links the local list appendices. Appendix C (https://www.broxbourne.gov.uk/downloads/file/4492/appendix-c) is machine-readable. Appendix B (householder, file 4489) has no extractable text, so it would need OCR. The workbook should link the appendices rather than only the parent page.
issues.evidence: Page links Appendix A (national), B (Householder Local Validation List), C (Local Validation List Depending on Development Type), D (Sustainability Checklist)

issues.detail: Grokbot captured no local requirements. Appendix C lists 26. Affordable Housing Statement (10+ dwellings or 0.5ha+). Agricultural Appraisal (agricultural workers' dwellings, or removal of occupancy conditions). Agricultural Land Survey (loss of agricultural land). Air Quality Impact Assessment (10+ units or 500 sq m+ in AQMAs; industrial uses with emissions). Archaeology Assessment (groundworks affecting the historic environment). Biodiversity/Ecology report (significant habitat or species impacts). BNG information (where the biodiversity gain condition applies). Daylight/Sunlight Assessment. Draft s106 Heads of Terms (major development). Drainage Strategy (all applications). FRA (FZ1 1ha+; all FZ2/3). Health Impact Assessment (50+ units or 2,500 sq m+). Heritage Statement. Land Contamination Assessment (previously developed land). Lighting Assessment (external lighting). Noise Impact Assessment. Recycling/Waste Strategy (all major development). Retail/Leisure Impact (2,500 sq m+ out of centre). SCI. Structural Survey (agricultural building conversions; partial demolition of heritage buildings). Supporting Planning Statement (major). Sustainability Checklist (new dwellings, conversions creating dwellings, new non-residential floorspace). TA/TS (use-class thresholds, e.g. C3 TS 50 / TA 80 units). Travel Plan (where a TA/TS is required). Tree Survey/AIA. Viability Assessment (policy departures on viability grounds).
issues.evidence: Appendix C: 'Local list of information which may be required depending on the development proposal'

issues.detail: No list date is recorded. The appendices show no date. The page metadata says March 2020, but Appendix C cites 2024 regulations, so the content is at least 2024. The date should be recorded as undated (post-2024 content), not left blank.
issues.evidence: Appendix C references 'Biodiversity Gain Requirements (Irreplaceable Habitat) Regulations 2024'

summary: Grokbot's link is the right official page and it works, but Grokbot wrongly marked it unreadable and captured nothing. The 26 local requirements in Appendix C, the householder Appendix B and the Sustainability Checklist are all missing.
